title: UI/collab: concurrent class editing can drop a remote peer's .as class
description: FIXED: concurrent class editing no longer drops a remote peer's .as class. Root cause: ClassesPanel debounced syncDocFromVfs treated 'in doc but not in local VFS' as a deletion; a remote peer's concurrently-added class (merged into doc.asClasses via per-class CRDT) was never mirrored to the local VFS during a pending edit, so the reconcile pushed a delete that wiped it for everyone. Fix: (1) syncDocFromVfs gained SyncRemoveMode ('all' default | 'none' | Set) — edit-time reconcile uses 'none' (never prunes doc-only classes = remote adds), remove/rename pass a Set of only the removed path; (2) the pending-edit re-hydrate branch now mirrors incoming remote classes into the VFS (skipping the file being typed) so they surface locally. Tests: core vfs-core.test.ts (remove-mode: all drops, none/Set keep), authoring-ui classesPanel.test.ts (remote class added while typing survives debounce + shows in tree; remove keeps concurrent remote add), collab binding.test.ts (two peers add different classes concurrently, both survive). Verify: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build exit 0; @flash/core 5753 passed; @flash/collab 46 passed; @flash/authoring-ui 1292 passed (exit 0). docs/37-collab.md updated.
